why: Both share the same sofa, table, bookcase and lamp. A's earth-toned herringbone jute rug fits the 'tonos tierra' brief and the warm wood floor and beams better than B's grey, fringed rug, which reads cooler and more rustic-boho. B's textured cushions and matte black pot are slightly more cohesive than A's colorful checked cushions and iridescent faceted planter, but not enough to offset the rug.
